target: PLAN.md L1 fast screen + objectives + S1-S9 (before the designer starts): ways a designer can score well on the screen without being better
claim: The designer is rewarded by the screening model (L1). As planned, L1 has exploitable gaps, and an optimiser will find them (Goodhart's law; specification gaming is documented for evolved designs, Lehman et al. 2020, Artificial Life 26:274, 'The surprising creativity of digital evolution'). Concrete exploits: (1) Calibration: the L1 posterior-element springs are to be calibrated on the physio runs, which are invalid (F-0001 / F-0002). (2) Preload gaming: the score is the friction needed (shear / compression). Over-sizing, spring-back after compressed insertion, and a large distraction gene d (up to 1.5 mm) all raise the normal force and lower mu_req in a linear-elastic, time-free L1. PLCL is a viscoelastic elastomer whose preload relaxes over days (magnitude unverified, not searched this round), and the ligament springs are extrapolated beyond their calibration. (3) Thin-feature stiffness: linear 8-node voxel hexes lock in bending when a strut is 1-2 voxels thick (shear locking, Hughes 2000, The Finite Element Method, ch. 4). The minimum feature is 2 voxels (S5), so thin lattices look stiffer than they are, and a linear L1 has no buckling and no material failure. (4) Staircase interlock: if L1 uses the voxel surface against the endplate, the steps can carry shear like small teeth. That is fake friction, and against the 'no bone penetration' rule in spirit. (5) Proxy gaming of M2 / M3 (F-0006): M3 rewards moving the pressure to the rim (twist capacity grows with radius), and neither indicator is the real slip. (6) Archive axis gaming: in the agreed material law E(phi) saturates, so E(0.5) = 649.53 = E(1.0) MPa (p062 case.json materials 30-32). 'Mean hard fraction' cells can then be filled with full-stiffness designs. (7) S4 gaming: 30 % void connected to both endplates can be met by a 0.2-0.4 mm sponge that cannot host a biodisc implant. S9 ('posterior push-out >= anterior') can be met by weakening the anterior side. (8) S2 checks only geometry after 0.8x compression. Hard PLCL (E 650 MPa, strength 15 MPa, so about 2.3 % elastic strain, p062 case.json) cannot take 20 % compression elastically, unless shape-memory programming is assumed (unverified, not stated in PLAN.md).
evidence: PLAN.md:16-17 (d gene, voxel 0.2 mm), :28-36 (S2, S4, S5, S9), :38-40 (objective mu_req, archive axes), :44-45 (L1 linear elastic, springs calibrated on physio runs); human_study/al_v2/cases/p062_physio/case.json 'materials' (E per phi, strength); DECISIONS.md:713 (compressed insertion 0.8).
how_to_reproduce: Read the cited lines; check E(phi) in any al_v2 case.json 'materials'.

fix_options.option: Before the designer starts: calibrate L1 only on corrected runs; keep an L1-L2 audit sample in every round chosen by the verifier (not by L1 rank), including the top designs, and stop promotion when the L1 rank does not predict the L2 rank (e.g. Spearman < 0.7)

Close the specific gaps: score mu_req with preload after relaxation (or without insertion preload) and with d fixed at the surgical value; use enhanced-strain or quadratic elements (or 2x voxel refinement) for thin features plus a linear buckling check; smooth (non-staircase) contact surface in L1; define S4 as a minimum inscribed channel / window size, not only a volume fraction; S9 as absolute push-out force, not a ratio; S2 with a material strain limit
fix_options.risk: medium (some are safety-guard / PI decisions - routed as CRs)

fix_options.option: Use 'mean stiffness' or 'mean E' as the archive axis instead of mean hard fraction

summary_zh: 設計者是依照快速篩選模型的分數獲得獎勵，而演化式最佳化很會鑽評分漏洞（文獻上已有許多例子）。目前計畫中可被利用的漏洞有：（1）篩選模型的後方彈簧，原定用錯誤的生理負荷結果來校正；（2）把 cage 做大一點、利用壓縮插入後的回彈，或把撐開距離調大，都能提高壓力、讓摩擦指標變好看，但聚己內酯共聚物（PLCL）的預壓力會隨時間鬆弛；（3）只有一兩個體素厚的細桿，在線性元素中會顯得過硬，而且線性模型不會算挫屈，也不會算破壞；（4）階梯狀的體素表面可能像小牙齒一樣卡住骨頭，形成假摩擦；（5）兩個摩擦指標本身都可以被刻意迎合；（6）材料硬度在混合比例 0.5 時就已經達到最大，所以「平均硬段比例」這個分類軸可以被灌水；（7）「生物椎間盤空間」可以用細小的海綿狀孔洞湊足體積，「往後推出力不小於往前推出力」也可以靠把前方弄弱來滿足；（8）硬的 PLCL 無法彈性壓縮 20% 再放進去。建議在設計者開始之前，先補上這些漏洞，並且每一輪都抽樣用完整模型核對。
